verdict.rationale: Figma's own marketing documents a built-in Figma agent that can generate design directions, create diagrams, edit images and search files, and Figma Make lets users iterate on code with AI. One community user reports an AI-summarized slide workflow, but another says FigJam's AI tools are 'really bad and often broken,' and the first-party evidence is marketing-level only. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on how tasks are delegated to the agent (multi-step execution, scope, review/approval of its changes), independent hands-on corroboration that the agent reliably completes delegated tasks, and clarity on availability across Figma surfaces.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Use the Figma agent to generate new design directions, create diagrams, edit images, search your files, and more.
Anyone can edit designs and riff with the agent to refine.
Teammates and AI agents work in the same space with shared context.
You can bring your own React code into Figma Make or Figma Sites and iterate on it using AI in the code editors.
